title: zensical-dirtree tree
description: A directory tree for the zensical-dirtree Markdown extension, as written in a tree file loaded with `src:` (or inside a ```dirtree fence).

root.description: Label shown above the tree and at the start of each breadcrumb.

selected.description: Id of the node selected on load. Default: the first node.

label.description: Display name. A trailing '/' or a 'children' key makes the node a folder.

id.description: Slug for deep links (#dirtree-<id>). Default: the slugified label path, e.g. src-main-py. Must be unique on the page.

summary.description: One line under the title, also shown in the parent's Contents list. Inline Markdown.

body.description: Markdown shown in the node's panel. Mutually exclusive with 'body_file'.

body_file.description: Markdown file for the panel, relative to the extension's base_path. Mutually exclusive with 'body'.

badges.description: Keys from the badge configuration in zensical.toml.

fields.description: Label/value callouts shown in the panel.

link.description: Target of a 'Full docs' link. Relative .md links are resolved like any page link.

children.description: Child nodes. Makes the node a folder.

icon.description: Icon override. Default: derived from type and file extension.
